The institutional investor held 57,000 shares of the television services company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $5.21 million, up from 27,000 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Clark Estates Inc who had been investing in Time Warner Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $73.39B market cap company. The stock increased 1.37% or $1.27 $93.81. About 4.10M shares traded. Time Warner Inc. (NYSE:TWX) has declined 3.25% downtrending. It has underperformed by 14.80% the S&P500.
Goelzer Investment Management Inc decreased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 6.23% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Goelzer Investment Management Inc sold 6,252 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.81% with the market. The institutional investor held 94,165 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $15.94 million, down from 100,417 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Goelzer Investment Management Inc who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $926.95 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.38% or $0.72 $188.59. About 25.70 million shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 19.49% uptrending. It has outperformed by 7.94% the S&P500.
